items.title: Nique Clifford Trade, Luka Raising the Lakers, Celtics Check, & Nuggets Convo | Third Apron Podcast
items.body_excerpt: The Thunder finally address their wing deficit by trading for Nique Clifford. We discuss that, as well as Luka Doncic’s historic start to the season, and gauge the Lakers as contenders. We also discuss the new-look Celtics and why the Nuggets have us concerned. You can follow…
